name: io.github.JOSETRA44/openalex-mcp
title: OpenAlex
description: Search 250M+ scholarly works, authors, institutions and journals in the open OpenAlex database. No API key required.

environmentVariables.name: OPENALEX_EMAIL

environmentVariables.name: OPENALEX_API_KEY
